youtube.title: Beethoven counted EXACTLY 60 coffee beans for every cup ☕ #shorts
youtube.caption:
Ludwig van Beethoven's strangest morning routine ☕

Team Beethoven or Team Housekeeper? Pick one 👇

Parody · fictional chat. Based on history: Beethoven's secretary Anton Schindler wrote that Beethoven made his coffee with exactly 60 beans per cup and often counted them out by hand, even after he had gone deaf.

#beethoven #ludwigvanbeethoven #classicalmusic #coffee #morningroutine #historymemes #shorts
